differangle.help:
/differangle - Differangle multi-viewport cameras
  World commands (game master permission; cameras are targeted by UUID)
    /differangle camera ...   camera entities: create / list / status / remove / tp / enabled / invisible / fov / fps / near / far / pose / move / look
    /differangle screen ...   screen bases: bind / enabled / configure / transform / status / mirror
  Local commands (affect only your own view)
    /differangle mode texture|embedded       picture source: cached frames / per-frame redraw
    /differangle layer <layer> <true|false>   toggle one render layer
    /differangle shaders <true|false>       toggle Texture camera shaders
    /differangle status                      render statistics
    /differangle list                        local Camera / Screen definitions
    /differangle copy <text>                 copy to clipboard
    /differangle preview demo|clear|...      throwaway prototype, never saved
  Press TAB after camera / screen for subcommand and argument completion; a branch without arguments prints its usage
differangle.camera.help:
/differangle camera - camera entities, always targeted by UUID
  list                            list all; clicking the name or [copy] copies the UUID, enabled=, [tp] and [remove] act on click
  create <name> [invisible]      create at eye level; invisible hides it, otherwise visible
  status   <UUID>                 position, FOV, FPS, visibility and enabled state
  remove   <UUID>                 delete it (bound screens keep the binding and show black)
  tp       <UUID>                 teleport yourself to that camera
  enabled  <UUID> <true|false>    switch that camera on or off
  invisible <UUID> <true|false>   hide or show the camera entity
  fov      <UUID> <1-179>         field of view
  fps      <UUID> <1-240>         update rate (texture mode)
  near     <UUID> <0.01-512>      near plane
  far      <UUID> <1-65536>       far plane
  pose     <UUID> <x y z yaw pitch roll> [ticks] [step|linear|smoothstep]   position and rotation, optionally tweened
  move     <UUID> <x y z> [ticks] [step|linear|smoothstep]         position only, optionally tweened
  look     <UUID> <yaw pitch roll> [ticks] [step|linear|smoothstep]  rotation only, optionally tweened
  The older /differangle camera <sub> <UUID> ... form still works

differangle.screen.help:
/differangle screen - screen bases, targeted by base position <x> <y> <z>
  bind      <x y z> <camera UUID|none>                          bind / unbind a camera
  enabled   <x y z> <true|false>                               switch the screen on or off
  configure <x y z> <width> <height> <resX> <resY> <fps>       size and resolution
  transform <x y z> <offsetX offsetY offsetZ> <yaw pitch roll> picture offset and rotation
  mirror    <x y z> <true|false>                               mirror mode
  source    <x y z> <camera|bilibili|video|image> [URL]         content source
  audio     <x y z> <enabled> <volume> <none|linear> <distance> audio settings
  playback  <x y z> <playing> <loop> <seconds>                  playback state
  status    <x y z>                                            current configuration
  Right-click a base to open the editor
differangle.screen.editor.title: Screen Settings
differangle.screen.editor.readonly: Read-only: game master permission is required
differangle.screen.editor.error.range: Value out of range: size 0.125-64, resolution 16-2048, FPS 1-240
differangle.mode.texture: Refreshed at the camera FPS; screens bound to one camera share a frame.
differangle.mode.embedded: Low-priority experimental mode: every screen is redrawn each frame; the camera FPS and colour cache are unused. Mirrors are Texture-only.
